text:
Asha: Alert - Prospect ran a demo replay and hit a burst of 5xxs at ~10:03PT. Traffic spiked ~300 rps. Sales and CISO on thread.

Priya: Which codes and model? Any sample req ids?

Asha: Mostly 502/503, some 504. Model: r-instruct-large-v1. IDs: f8a1c2, 9b3d4e. Payloads are small but highly concurrent.

Ben: Traces show frontdoor queue growth -> worker grpc UNAVAILABLE (code=14) when backlog > ~110. Autoscaler added nodes but new pods stayed NotReady ~18s due to quant kernel init. No OOM.

Lina: Short fixes: enable tenant warm pool for the demo, set tenant max_batch=1, and enable fallback to r-instruct-medium-quant on overload. Also recommend client retry (2) with jitter.

deploy-bot: autoscaler: scale request accepted for demo-pool (+3) at 10:04:12

Priya: Sales wants cost impact for warm pool for 3h demo window.

Lina: Ballpark: prewarm ~ $0.60/hr -> ~$1.80 for 3h. We can cover first hour as a one-off concession on trials.

deploy-bot: apply: tenant(prospect).max_batch=1 -> accepted
deploy-bot: apply: tenant(prospect).fallback=r-instruct-medium-quant -> accepted

Priya: Uploaded diagnostic bundle for CISO: https://redwood-internal/diag/2901234567 (frontdoor spans, worker logs, model load timestamps). Note: audit bundles redact prompt text by default; for unredacted transfer we require a signed access request.

Ben: After changes queue drained and 5xx rate fell from ~13% -> 0.7% within 7m. Monitoring continuing.

sales-bot: Customer asked for a "no 5xx" guarantee.

security-bot: Official stance: cannot guarantee zero 5xxs on hosted trials. Offer Dedicated with SLA for contractual guarantees. For demos we provide mitigations and a practice replay.

Priya: Suggested customer-facing note: "We applied tenant fallback, reduced batch size, and provisioned a prewarm instance for the demo window (estimate $1.80 for 3h). Diagnostics link and redaction policy provided to your security team. We recommend a 2-min practice run at demo start."

Asha: Sales will send that. Ops will revert temporary configs after 6h unless extended. Thanks team.
